title: CHOCOLATE ICING
instructions: 1/4 cake chocolate.  1/2 cup sweet milk.  1 tablespoonful corn-starch.  1 teaspoonful vanilla.  Mix together these ingredients, with the exception of the vanilla; boil it two minutes (after it has fairly come to a boil), flavor, and then sweeten to taste with powdered sugar, taking care to make it sweet enough.
